fact: Law n° 2016-056, adopted 14 and 16 December 2016, sets user-protection rules for electronic money (prior information, written agreement with a one-week withdrawal right, a customer service open at all times to handle complaints, free complaint handling) and gives the CSBF disciplinary and pecuniary sanctions.
title: LOI n° 2016-056 sur la monnaie électronique et les établissements de monnaie électronique
